title: The present tense
summary: Find a verb's stem and use the present tense in `-ýAr` to say what people are doing, what they do every day and what they will do soon; make it negative and ask questions with it.
canDo: Say what you and others are doing now
Talk about everyday habits and plans for tomorrow
Say what you don't know, want or understand
Ask what someone is doing, and whether they understand
